skills.name: meeting-recap
skills.description: Turn messy notes into a crisp meeting recap with owners and next steps.
skills.readme: Useful when the user pastes notes and wants an action-focused recap.
skills.skillContent:
---
name: meeting-recap
description: Convert meeting notes into a concise recap.
category: productivity
---

# Meeting Recap

1. Extract decisions, risks, and owners.
2. Group next steps into a short flat list.
3. Keep the final output concise and skimmable.

skills.skillContent:

# Daily Digest

1. Review today's relevant context.
2. Highlight completed work, blockers, and follow-ups.
3. Keep the summary ready for chat or email delivery.
